description: This file implements the 'Label' class and related functions for handling dependency labels in a build system, including parsing, resolving, and generating user-visible label names.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a build dependency label, including its directory, name, and optional toolchain information.

methods.name: DirWithNoTrailingSlash
methods.description: Returns the directory path without a trailing slash, unless the path is just '/' or '//'.

methods.name: ComputeBuildLocationFromDep
methods.description: Computes the final build location directory from a dependency input, considering relative paths.

methods.name: ComputeTargetNameFromDep
methods.description: Computes the target name from a dependency input, using implicit naming conventions if necessary.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Parses and resolves a label string into directory, name, and toolchain components, handling relative and absolute paths.
